arxiv-2012-05051.title: Consistently recovering the signal from noisy functional data
arxiv-2012-05051.creator: Siegfried Hörmann
arxiv-2012-05051.description: Abstract In practice most functional data cannot be recorded on a continuum, but rather at discrete time points. It is also quite common that these measurements come with an additive error, which one would like eliminate for the statistical analysis.

arxiv-2201-02368.title: Systematic treatment of hypernuclear data and application to the hypertriton
arxiv-2201-02368.creator: P. Eckert, a,∗ P. Achenbach, a,b M. Aragonès Fontboté, a T. Akiyama, c M.O. Distler, a A. Esser, a J. Geratz, a M. Hoek, a K. Itabashi, c M. Kaneta, c R. Kino, c P. Klag, a H. Merkel, a M. Mizuno, c J. Müller, a U. Müller, a S. Nagao, c S.N. Nakamura, c Y.R. Nakamura, c K. Okuyama, c J. Pochodzalla,
arxiv-2201-02368.description: Abstract A database is under construction to provide a complete collection of published basic properties of hypernuclei such as Λ \Lambda binding energies, lifetimes, or excitation energies. From these values, averages with related errors are computed in a systematic way.

arxiv-2308-04609.title: Topological k k -metrics
arxiv-2308-04609.creator: Willow Barkan-Vered, Huck Bennett, Amir Nayyeri
arxiv-2308-04609.description: Abstract Metric spaces ( X , d ) (X,d) are ubiquitous objects in mathematics and computer science that allow for capturing (pairwise) distance relationships d ⁡ ( x , y ) d(x,y) between points x , y ∈ X x,y\in X .

arxiv-2311-06050.title: On p p -Frobenius of affine semigroups
arxiv-2311-06050.creator: Evelia R. García Barroso, J. I. García-García
arxiv-2311-06050.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to study the p p -Frobenius vector of affine semigroups S ⊂ ℕ q S\subset\mathbb{N}^{q} ; that is, the maximum element, with respect to a graded monomial order, with at most p p factorizations in S S . We produce several algorithms to compute these vectors.

arxiv-2502-18918.title: Parallel spatial photonic Ising machine using spatial multiplexing for accelerating combinatorial optimization
arxiv-2502-18918.creator: Suguru Shimomura, Jun Tanida, Yusuke Ogura
arxiv-2502-18918.description: Abstract A spatial photonic Ising machine (SPIM) handles large-scale combinatorial optimization problems owing to optical processing with spatial parallelism. However, iterative feedback in the search for optimal solutions limits processing speed even though the Ising Hamiltonian is computed optically. We propose a parallel spatial photonic Ising machine (pSPIM) utilizing spatial multiplexing to search for an optimal solution efficiently.

arxiv-2505-15293.title: LLM-Explorer: A Plug-in Reinforcement Learning Policy Exploration Enhancement Driven by Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-15293.creator: Qianyue Hao, Yiwen Song, Qingmin Liao, Jian Yuan, Yong Li
arxiv-2505-15293.description: Abstract Policy exploration is critical in reinforcement learning (RL), where existing approaches include ϵ \epsilon -greedy, Gaussian process, etc. However, these approaches utilize preset stochastic processes and are indiscriminately applied in all kinds of RL tasks without considering task-specific features that influence policy exploration.

arxiv-2508-17852.title: Cross-Domain Lifelong Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Sensor Networks This paper benefited from language revision assistance provided by ChatGPT, a language model developed by OpenAI. The authors take full responsibility for the content of the manuscript.
arxiv-2508-17852.creator: Hossein Mohammadi Firouzjaei 1 , Rafaela Scaciota 1 2 , Sumudu Samarakoon 1 2 , and Beatriz Lorenzo 3
arxiv-2508-17852.description: Abstract Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) with energy harvesting (EH) are expected to play a vital role in intelligent 6 6 G systems, particularly in applications such as industrial sensing and control, where continuous operations and sustainable energy management are essential. Given their limited energy resources, WSNs require energy-efficient operations to maintain long-term performance.

arxiv-2509-24037.title: Automated Vulnerability Validation and Verification: A Large Language Model Approach
arxiv-2509-24037.creator: Alireza Lotfi, Charalampos Katsis, Elisa Bertino
arxiv-2509-24037.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alireza Lotfi, Charalampos Katsis, Elisa Bertino. Software vulnerabilities remain a critical security challenge, providing entry points for attackers to compromise enterprise networks. Despite advances in security practices, the lack of high-quality datasets capturing the behavior of diverse exploits hinders effective vulnerability assessment and mitigation. This paper introduces an end-to-end multi-step pipeline leveraging generative AI, specifically large language models (LLMs), to address the challenges of orchestrating and reproducing attacks to known software vulnerabilities in controlled environments.

arxiv-2510-25623.title: Evaluating the Role of Verifiers in Test-Time Scaling for Legal Reasoning Tasks
arxiv-2510-25623.creator: Davide Romano, Jonathan Richard Schwarz, Daniele Giofrè
arxiv-2510-25623.description: Abstract Test-time scaling (TTS) techniques can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) at the expense of additional computation and latency. While TTS has proven effective in formal domains such as mathematics and programming ( Snell et al. 2024 ; Chen et al. 2024 ) , its value in argumentative domains such as law remains underexplored.

arxiv-2512-04358.title: MAFNet: Multi-frequency Adaptive Fusion Network for Real-time Stereo Matching
arxiv-2512-04358.creator: Ao Xu 2 , Rujin Zhao 3,6 , Xiong Xu 1,2,4,5 , Boceng Huang 1 , Yujia Jia 2, Hongfeng Long 3 , Fuxuan Chen 1 , Zilong Cao 1 , Fangyuan Chen
arxiv-2512-04358.description: Abstract Existing stereo matching networks typically rely on either cost-volume construction based on 3D convolutions or deformation methods based on iterative optimization. The former incurs significant computational overhead during cost aggregation, whereas the latter often lacks the ability to model non-local contextual information. These methods exhibit poor compatibility on resource-constrained mobile devices, limiting their deployment in real-time applications.

pmc-10621076.title: Cluster features in fibrosing interstitial lung disease and associations with prognosis
pmc-10621076.creator: Yuanying Wang, Di Sun, Jingwei Wang, Shiwen Yu, Na Wu, Qiao Ye
pmc-10621076.description: BackgroundClustering is helpful in identifying subtypes in complex fibrosing interstitial lung disease (F-ILD) and associating them with prognosis at an early stage of the disease to improve treatment management. We aimed to identify associations between clinical characteristics and outcomes in patients with F-ILD.MethodsRetrospectively, 575 out of 926 patients with F-ILD were eligible for analysis.

pmc-10688147.title: Cytoreductive surgery is feasible in patients with limited regional platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer
pmc-10688147.creator: Ruoyao Zou, Qidi Jiang, Xukai Luo, Mo Chen, Lei Yuan, Liangqing Yao
pmc-10688147.description: IntroductionTo evaluate the efficacy of cytoreductive surgery versus chemotherapy for the treatment of limited regional, platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC).Materials and methodsThe clinical records of all patients with PROC treated in our center between March 2015 and March 2022 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11437740.title: Malrotated subhepatic caecum with subhepatic appendicitis: Diagnostic dilemma: A case report
pmc-11437740.creator: Biniam Addis Anelay, Alemneh Mitku Chekol, Workye Tigabie, Michael Sintayew, Elleni Tadesse
pmc-11437740.description: IntroductionAcute appendicitis is among common surgical emergency. Subhepatic appendicitis is rare and difficult to diagnose and manage. There are few case reports across the world.Case presentationWe presented a case of 7 year's old child with no known medical illness presented with acute onset vague abdominal pain experienced for three days.

pmc-11503960.title: Simulated resections and responsive neurostimulator placement can optimize postoperative seizure outcomes when guided by fast ripple networks
pmc-11503960.creator: Shennan Aibel Weiss, Michael R Sperling, Jerome Engel, Anli Liu, Itzhak Fried, Chengyuan Wu, Werner Doyle, Charles Mikell, Sima Mofakham, Noriko Salamon, Myung Shin Sim, Anatol Bragin, Richard Staba
pmc-11503960.description: In medication-resistant epilepsy, the goal of epilepsy surgery is to make a patient seizure free with a resection/ablation that is as small as possible to minimize morbidity. The standard of care in planning the margins of epilepsy surgery involves electroclinical delineation of the seizure-onset zone and incorporation of neuroimaging findings from MRI, PET, single-photon emission CT and magnetoencephalography modalities.

pmc-11558915.title: Diabetic ketoacidosis as first presentation of undiagnosed pancreatic cancer in an octogenarian
pmc-11558915.creator: Minh V Le, Spiros Fourlanos, Rahul D Barmanray
pmc-11558915.description: SummaryDiabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) is a complication of diabetes mellitus (DM) that can theoretically occur in people of any age. While DKA can typically be the first presentation of type 1 DM in younger people, a first presentation is rare in older adults. Pancreatic cancer often manifests with new DM or hyperglycaemia, but very rarely as DKA.

pmc-12794002.title: Multicenter Practice of Non/Minimized Fluoroscopy Ablation for Paroxysmal AF in China
pmc-12794002.creator: Yunhe Wang, Deyong Long, Fangyi Xiao, Minglong Chen, Xingpeng Liu, Jidong Zhang, Yumei Xue, Jie Fan, Haixiong Wang, Mengzuo Wu, Rui Wang, Jia Li, Tao He, Weili Ge, Xiaobo Huang, Ruhong Jiang, Qiang Liu, Zuwen Zhang, Guosheng Fu, Chenyang Jiang
pmc-12794002.description: BackgroundIntracardiac echocardiography (ICE)-guided non/minimized-fluoroscopy catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) has been reported, but its effectiveness and safety still lack multicenter evidence.ObjectivesThe authors sought to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of ICE-guided non/minimized-fluoroscopy catheter ablation compared with the traditional fluoroscopy-guided approach in patients with paroxysmal AF.

pmc-13113516.title: Promoting Flourishing at Work: Innovations in Positive Work and Organisational Psychology
pmc-13113516.creator: Rona Hart, Dan Hart
pmc-13113516.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). me, the workplace can also be a source of tension, conflict, and distress. In the 21st century, attending to occupational wellbeing is therefore no longer a peripheral concern but a strategic imperative for sustainable organisations. Positive Work and Organisational Psychology (or Positive Work and Organisations) has emerged as a dynamic and increasingly influential field of scholarship and practice concerned with how work can be designed, led, and experienced in ways that promote human flourishing while also supporting sustainable organisational performance and productivity.

pmc-13642469.title: Dispersion‐Engineered Broadband Transparent Meta‐Cloak
pmc-13642469.creator: Dan Liu, Xingshuo Cui, Chunsheng Guan, Xiaochun Liu, Wenye Ji, Fei Gao, Tong Cai
pmc-13642469.description: Electromagnetic (EM) cloaking technology has evolved significantly through diverse approaches, with particular prominence in the field of EM transparent cloaking ‐ most notably transformation optics. Although substantial progress has been made in the control of EM transparent cloaking, developing an effective method to achieve broadband transparent cloaking remains an urgent and core engineering physics challenge.

pmc-13675500.title: Resource use by threatened, native Bull Trout (Salvelinus confluentus) in the presence of two non‐native salmonids
pmc-13675500.creator: Jacqueline Pallard, Tim Jardine, Mark S. Poesch
pmc-13675500.description: Introduction of non‐native species contributes to the global decline of freshwater fishes by disrupting the diet and resources of native species through competition. Despite the potential for non‐native trout (Family: Salmonidae) to compete with native trout, non‐native trout species have been widely introduced worldwide to support recreational fishing.
